findings.detail: ADK rejects 'lead-researcher'; the adapter uses 'lead_researcher' and retains a bidirectional identity map.
LlmAgent.description is native agent and AgentTool selection metadata.
A native instruction callback returns the Markdown literally on each run, avoiding ADK state-template interpolation.
The external binding attests the capability for the injected ADK BaseLlm.

The framework has no Agent Skills concept. The adapter supplies the dedicated tool activation pattern of the Agent Skills integration guide: catalog in the tool description, full body returned on demand as a tool result.
Activated skill content enters context as a tool result. Whether it survives context compaction or summarization for the rest of the session was not exercised.
Agent Skills requires references, scripts, and assets to be reachable on demand. The fixture skills bundle no resources, so on-demand resource access was not exercised.
Agent Plugin MCP servers become native McpToolset objects available to the declaring agent, with transport configuration preserved.
Native MCP clients were constructed from the plugin configuration, but no handshake, tool discovery, or invocation was exercised in this build.
AgentTool is a bounded nested run, but it copies parent state into a fresh session and propagates child state deltas back.
